projects.title: Sweet Danger
projects.description:
We were asked by Accessible Quality Healthcare Project (AQH) to create an awareness campaign about diabetes, describing the four main issues concerning this disease: signs, causes, risks and treatment.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fJU2rGm02HI

The campaign was aimed for members of the lower socio-economic class, that have little or no knowledge about diabetes and its consequences, potentially leading to serious health complications and even death, if not treated early.
